headline: Pakistan reached 390-6 at lunch on day two of the first Test against Sri Lanka in Rawalpindi on Tuesday, with Saud Shakeel 91 not out, nine short of his fifth Test hundred.

card.desc: Saud Shakeel is 91 not out, nine short of a hundred.

caption:
Pakistan reach 390-6 at lunch on day two against Sri Lanka! 🏏
According to Dawn, Pakistan lost only one wicket in the morning session of the first Test in Rawalpindi on Tuesday. Saud Shakeel is 91 not out off 192 balls, nine runs short of his fifth Test hundred. Ghazi Ghori made 48, and Arafat Minhas is 27 not out.
Will Saud Shakeel score his hundred today? Tell us in the comments 👇
